title: PolySynth: voice ADSR not independent — releases collapse together + pop on stop with multiple voices
description: Gate-2 round 3: notes started at different times end at the same time, but each voice ADSR should be independent. Also voices pop on stop, but only when multiple are playing. LIKELY CORE BUG in packages/core/src/poly-synth.ts (shared bus / shared gain automation cancelling per-voice envelopes? gain.cancelScheduledValues on shared node kills sibling releases?). Investigate voice lifecycle: each Oscillator has own envelope; check if noteOff/stop path cancels automation on the SHARED bus or all voices. Add unit tests for overlapping note on/off. Page /examples/polysynth.

title: TransportSequencer: start/stop buggy — notes after stop, hanging bass notes
description: Gate-2 round 3: pressing Stop often still plays notes afterward (already-scheduled events not cancelled), and funk groove sometimes leaves bass notes hanging (oscillator never stopped/released). Check Transport stop semantics: does stop() cancel queued lookahead-scheduled events? Hanging voices = missing release/stop on bass oscillator instances. Likely part core (Transport/Sequence scheduling cancel) part demo — apply library-fidelity rule.

title: SoundfontPiano: click at note start + add smooth decay before ~4s sample end
description: Gate-2 round 3: notes click when they start; also should decay smoothly right before natural note end (~4s) instead of truncating. Start click: likely instant gain at play — check SampledNote/Font play path (may be core, library-fidelity rule). End: schedule short gain ramp-out near buffer end. Page /examples/soundfont-piano.

title: EffectsChain: replace droning synth source with transient/dynamic material
description: Gate-2 round 3: 'needs something transient with dynamics. this ongoing droning synth doesn't showcase the effects at all.' Delay needs transients to echo, compressor needs dynamics to squash, EQ/reverb read better on percussive/plucked material. Use a drum loop or plucked/staccato sequence as the demo source (keep oscillator as secondary source option — source switching restored in 72-01 was deliberate). Page /examples/effects-chain, EffectsChainDemo.vue. Keep loudness E2E green.

title: TransportSequencer: content depends on prior start/stop of other pattern (state leak)
description: Gate-2 round 3: plays different content depending on whether straight-rock was started+stopped first. Pattern-switch state leak — sequences/transport position/scheduled events surviving pattern change. Verify clean re-init on pattern switch and on stop.

title: TransportSequencer: funk/groove start makes screechy sound
description: Gate-2 round 3: starting funk/groove pattern produces a strange screechy sound. Suspects: bass oscillator freq ramp/glide artifact, overlapping scheduled notes, or filter resonance. Reproduce, isolate layer by layer.

title: TransportSequencer: musical design review — audio makes no sense (EPIC)
description: Gate-2 round 3 (Seth): 'The audio generally doesn't make any sense. This needs a serious design review and rethink from a musical perspective.' Umbrella for the TransportSequencer rework: pattern content (straight rock / funk groove) should sound musically coherent — sensible drum pattern, bass line that implies harmony, piano comping that fits. Rethink note choices, velocities, register, and mix. Child bugs: screech on funk start, start/stop bugs, pattern-dependent state leak, layout overflow. Page /examples/transport-sequencer, component TransportSequencerDemo.vue.

title: SynthDrumKit: bass drop too long — port ember-audio original settings
description: Gate-2 round 3: bass drop decay too long. Consult original ember-audio source (github sethbrasile/ember-audio, drum machine demo) for its bass-drop oscillator settings (freq sweep + decay times) and match. Page /examples/synth-drum-kit, component SynthDrumKit.vue.

title: XYPad: small clicks/pops when changing gain with note held
description: Gate-2 round 3: dragging XY pad while note held clicks slightly on gain changes. Page /examples/xy-pad, component XYPad.vue. Likely instant gain sets per pointermove — needs ramped changes (compare Ambient fadeGainTo pattern / linearRampToValueAtTime). If demo must hand-roll, that is the changeGainTo-has-no-ramp library gap already logged in M8-QUESTIONS (2026-07-10 gate-2 entry) — consider fixing in core instead.

title: Ambient: redesign sound from research — current audio not pleasing
description: Gate-2 round 3 (Seth): 'the actual audio of the ambient sound generator is not good.' Research pleasing synthesized ambient techniques (detuned oscillator stacks, slow filter/LFO movement, chord voicings, reverb/space, filtered noise beds) and replicate something similar. Current 3 layers: 80Hz sine drone + lowpass white noise + 600Hz triangle shimmer — too crude. Component: docs/.vitepress/theme/components/AmbientGenerator.vue. Library-fidelity rule: build via ez-web-audio API; log any gaps (reverb? detune spread?) to M8-QUESTIONS.md. Keep loudness E2E green (peak <=0.985, >=0.05).

title: GrainPlayer: pad preset sounds like decaying piano, not a pad
description: Gate-2 round 3: Pad preset just sounds like a naturally decaying piano note. A pad needs sustained evolving texture: high overlap, longer grains, slower/scattered position advance (freeze-ish spray), maybe pitch spread. Retune preset params until it sustains like a pad. Page /examples/grainplayer, component GrainPlayerDemo (docs theme). LFO + other presets confirmed good — do not touch.

title: TransportSequencer: grid overflows viewport — widen or fewer beats
description: Gate-2 round 3: sequencer too long, extends past screen edge even on wide device. Either let grid use available width (fluid layout, page could allow wider container) or reduce beat count so it fits. Coordinate with 74-02 design-cohesion work (.planning/DESIGN-HANDOFF/).
